description: This file defines the OpenApiConfig class which configures the OpenAPI specifications for a Spring Boot application, including API metadata, server URL derivation from request headers, and fallback URLs for preview environments.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up OpenAPI documentation, including API info, servers, and URL derivation logic.

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAPI object with metadata and server configuration.

methods.name: deriveServerUrlFromRequest
methods.description: Attempts to construct the server URL from current HTTP request headers, considering reverse proxy headers.
